title: I've just had an operation or surgery - can I legally drive?
description:
It depends on the operation. Always ask your doctor's advice, as they'll be able to let you know when you can safely drive.

If you get behind the wheel while it isn't safe, you could invalidate your insurance. This means if you had an accident, we could reject your claim.

Check out our guide on how to make sure you're healthy enough to drive.
